headline: Segob calls on corn producers to avoid blockades; says there is dialogue
summary: Interior Secretary Rosa Icela Rodríguez asked white corn producers in the Bajío region to prefer dialogue and avoid road blockades ahead of planned protests on Tuesday, November 17.
why: White corn is a staple grain in Mexico, and farmer protests and road blockades can disrupt grain transport and domestic food supply chains.
original_headline: Segob llama a productores de maíz a evitar bloqueos; asegura que hay diálogo
